# Keep attachment header arrays and decoded values in the API contract

convertHeaders produces arrays even for single values, decodes ordinary MIME headers and handles address headers separately. MessageAttachment.headers uses this conversion, so it is not byte-for-byte raw mail. Nested message attachments read message headers from the first subpart, distinct from the enclosing attachment headers. Keep that distinction when using listAttachments instead of walking getFull. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: WebExtension attachment header representation.
